text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the State Grants (Main-
tenance of Local Authorities) Act 1981 and shall be
deemed to have come into force on the Ist January

2. (1) The Federation may from time to time make
a grant to any State for the maintenance of local
authorities in that State.

(2) The amount of the grant made under subsection
(1) shall be determined by the Minister responsible for
local government after consultation with the Minister
of Finance.
